verdict.rationale: ClickHouse's first-party docs describe native exact and approximate vector search written directly in SQL, with ANN indexes on MergeTree tables and tunable accuracy/speed trade-offs, so no separate vector database is needed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how embeddings are stored (column types for vectors), evidence on index types or performance at scale, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of the vector search feature.
